findings.motion: S 921 Const. Am./Require Photo ID For All Voters, House Second Reading, Roll Call #809
findings.note: The House Roll Call #809 transcript lists Charles Smith among the Noes. The vote was 73 ayes to 45 noes. The bill proposes a constitutional amendment requiring photo ID for all voters, including by mail, for the Nov 2026 ballot (see https://news.ballotpedia.org/?p=40131).
subjects: ID with mail or absentee ballot

findings.motion: S 921 Const. Am./Require Photo ID For All Voters, House Third Reading, Roll Call #810
findings.note: The House Roll Call #810 transcript lists Charles Smith among the Noes. The vote was 73 ayes to 45 noes on the same photo ID constitutional amendment.
subjects: ID with mail or absentee ballot

findings.motion: H 958 Election Law Changes, House Second Reading, Roll Call #758
findings.note: The transcript lists Charles Smith among the Noes. The vote was 66 ayes to 47 noes. Bill text (ratified version, https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) includes a rule that a county board processes a registration only if the applicant affirmatively states US citizenship, a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens from a federal database, and deceased-voter list removals.
subjects: removal of non-citizens from voter rolls

findings.motion: H 958 Election Law Changes, House motion M11 to concur with the Senate committee substitute, Roll Call #801
findings.note: The transcript lists Charles Smith among the Noes. The vote was 62 ayes to 47 noes. The bill page (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958) shows the bill was ratified and then vetoed by the Governor on 08/17/2026.
subjects: removal of non-citizens from voter rolls
